title: A WO demo's share link shows the owner other looks in preview only and records which look the owner liked
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: demoSystemChoice offers the library's featured systems it offers, in the featured order, without the worn system; systemsOf answers the first four whose bytes the template's contract emits, numbered 1 to 4, each with a tracy_ds_preview ticket whose claims name this site, that system, the judged contract and template, and no other site.

systemsOf answers no look with reason NOT_WIRED, PLATFORM, IMPORTED, NOT_SERVED_HERE, NO_ADDRESS, SITE_UNREADABLE, NO_SLOT, TEMPLATE_LOCKED (the customer lock asked with a null email), NO_SYSTEM or NO_SITE; eligible answers without a read in the container and false on any doubt.
The minted ticket read by the site proxy's live page lays in the system's slot, takes the worn slot off and leaves the page's own content and stylesheet unchanged.

The share page frames the asked demo page, keeps its control hidden until looks load, names no library system, escapes its title and data block, and its CSP allows frame-src of the demo origin only with frame-ancestors 'none'.

Switch wo-demo-looks is in the catalogue and off by default: /d/<token> is a 302 and both looks doors answer 404 FEATURE_OFF; on, a person's top-level visit of an eligible demo gets the 200 share page (counted as an open), while a link preview, a prefetch, a frame, a HEAD or an ineligible demo get the 302.
GET /api/demo-links/<token>/systems answers ids, numbers, palettes and tickets but no names, its reason when none, 429 past 120 reads an hour.

POST /api/demo-links/<token>/systems/pick writes one wo_demo_system_pick row (columns device, id, link_id, n, name, picked_at, system_id) for a person; a program, the seller's own session and picks past 30 an hour answer counted false and write nothing; 403 CSRF_ORIGIN without same-origin Fetch Metadata or Tracy's Origin, 415, 400 INVALID_LOOK and LOOK_NOT_OFFERED, 404 for a stopped link, 410 for a deleted demo; demo.systemPicks and /ops/wo demoSystemPicks read total 3 newest first.
fence: The share link hands out only Design system preview tickets judged by the running site's gates, writes nothing to the demo, and records a pick only for a person on Tracy's own page.

tests: the systems offered are the featured ones the library offers, in the featured order, without the worn one
a demo offers its first four featured systems its contract emits, each a preview ticket for exactly that system
a demo that cannot wear a look offers none, and says why
eligible answers without a read in the container: the release can wear a system and its template is open
a read in the container is trusted two minutes, then read again
a look changes only what an apply would write: the worn slot goes, the system’s slot comes, nothing else moves
the share page frames the asked demo page, hides its control until looks load, and carries no system name
the share page may frame the demo origin only, and refuses to be framed itself
the switch is in the catalogue, off by default, and read as off when it cannot be read
a pick is judged a program by its User-Agent alone
switch off: the share link is the plain 302 and the looks and pick doors are closed
switch on: a person’s own visit of a demo that can wear a look gets the share page, counted like the 302
switch on, but the demo cannot wear a look: the plain 302
the looks door answers numbers, palettes and tickets, never a library name, and says why when there are none
a demo the looks module refuses offers no look, with its reason
looks served on another origin than the share link’s demo are not offered
a person’s pick is counted like an open; a program, the seller and picks past the cap are answered and not written
a build whose link was never opened reads zero picks; one with no link reads none
